title: fix(pylint): top lint fixes — encodings, logging, exception chaining, test tidy
head: fix/pylint-top-fixes-1
body:
This PR contains a set of low-risk, high-ROI lint fixes to improve code quality and Pylint score:

- Added explicit encoding="utf-8" to open() calls where appropriate to avoid W1514.
- Converted f-string logging to lazy logging (e.g., logger.info("...%s", value)) to avoid logging-fstring-interpolation (W1203).
- Chained exceptions using `raise ... from exc` to preserve tracebacks and satisfy raise-missing-from (W0707).
- Moved some test imports to module top, removed static f-strings and minor housekeeping in tests.

Files changed in this PR (initial batch):
- src/modules/utils.py
- src/modules/souls_manager.py
- tests/test_ai_content.py
- tests/test_ai_phase1.py

Notes:
- Larger refactors (duplicate code R0801; too-many-statements R0915; test restructuring) will be addressed in follow-up PRs to keep review scope small.
- Please pull/rebase your local branches before pushing if you have local commits.
